Class ModelBeanBase

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.dao.ModelBeanBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelBean
Direct Known Subclasses:
AliasBean, ApiClientBean, AttributedModelBean, CategoryBean, ChangeLogBean, CountryBean, DataFileBean, DataTransferBaseBean, DestinationBean, DestinationMetaDataBean, EcTransModuleBean, EcUserBean, HostBean, IncomingPolicyBean, IncomingUserBean, MetaDataBean, MonitoringParametersBaseBean, MonitoringStatusBean, OperationBean, RatesBean, ResourceBean, StatusBean, TrafficBean, TransferGroupBean, TransferHistoryBean, TransferMethodBean, TransferServerBean, UserBean
public abstract class ModelBeanBase extends Object implements ModelBean
ModelBeanBase.java

A base class, implementing the interface ModelBean, that includes some features that are thought to be of interest for all the ModelBean implementations. Many ModelBean's will extend this class instead of implementing the ModelBean interface.

This common features are:

  • Management of a bean "id"
  • Implementation of save,insert,delete methods which use DAOService.
